title: I created an endless boss fight with different artstyles and hidden glitches to unlock.
author: Sudden_Network621
selftext: What kind of boss fight and artstyle would you like to see? I do some different tests what artstyles, boss fights and glitches would fit. I want the glitches to be fun not necessary overpowered to add some humoristic touches into it. :) what do you guys think?

comments.body: No consistency? Make it part of the game design 👌

replies.author: Sudden_Network621
replies.body: My idea was to showcase the generation of different eras of gaming, I grew up with SNES and Game Boy, so I wanted to show this evolution until I'm able to make at the end some 3D boss fights :)
